materials_exhausted.note: Local source/packet contains XML, PDF, OA package figures, and linked DRAMP rows. Source supplementary directories and packet supplementary index were opened and contain no supplementary assets for this paper.

summary: Worker-2/4/6 re-review rebuilt the missing activity layer from primary XML/PDF/figure evidence, adjudicated all linked DRAMP rows with sequence/activity conflicts preserved, and replaced the framework-test review with source-reviewed final adjudication.
adjudication_summary: The prior ticket is closed: supported anticancer cytotoxicity/apoptosis rows are now present, database-only antimicrobial/activity annotations are not promoted, and final acceptance is limited to accepted_with_cautions because source conflicts and figure-only approximations remain explicit.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: Three DRAMP peptide records and their experiment/activity/literature links were checked against primary Table 1 and article metadata. DRAMP35255 remains source_conflict for sequence/name mismatch; DRAMP antimicrobial/anticancer annotations are conflict-preserved where unsupported by primary assays.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Primary XML/PDF/figure evidence supports TP10-SRC1LXXLL cytotoxicity in MCF-7 and MDA-MB-231 cells, fibroblast toxicity at higher concentration, and annexin V/7-AAD apoptosis. Exact figure source data are absent, so figure-derived percentages are marked as approximations.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Directly supported mechanism is apoptosis by annexin V/7-AAD plus cellular uptake/localization. ER-transcription inhibition is bounded as unsupported by the reported qRT-PCR result, and speculative intracellular targets remain hypotheses.
per_layer_decision_rationale.supplementary_material: Packet and paper-local supplementary directories/indexes were opened; no supplementary assets are present, so no supplement-derived row is available or required for this paper.

caution_findings.evidence_context: DRAMP35255 name is TP10-SRC1LXXLL but sequence matches the TP10-SRC11222-1245 control fragment rather than the Table 1 LXXLL sequence.
DRAMP antimicrobial/anticancer labels are broader than the primary paper; antimicrobial activity is not assayed in the local source and control peptides did not show anticancer survival effects.
Figures 1 and 4 provide plotted values without local numeric source tables; approximate rows are marked manual_approximation_from_paper_figure.
